title: Tracy AI is an entry of the AI account order: last by default, a new connection stands before it, a conversation on Tracy AI by configuration follows the order, and the saved order must name every connection and Tracy AI exactly once
steps: S1: run the tracy-web seat-plan broker, db and onboarding door tests (node:test, Postgres through TEST_DATABASE_URL; a suite that skips for lack of it does not count).
S2: the end-to-end form is S2–S4 and S8 of tasks/evidence/ai-accounts-unify/stand/REPORT.md.
expect: An account with nothing connected has Tracy AI as its whole order and the status carries no tracyFallback.
A new connection stands before Tracy AI while Tracy AI is last, else after everything.
PUT /api/seat-plan/routing refuses an order that misses a connection or Tracy AI, or names one twice; a tracyFallback field is ignored.

A subscription after Tracy AI in the order is not tried when the one before it hits its limit; Tracy AI first pins the conversation to Tracy AI at once and it stays there while Tracy AI stays first; once a subscription is put first, a conversation on Tracy AI by configuration follows.
An account with no connection at all keeps the plain pin (the deployment default, no broker turn).
Migration 095 gives every saved order Tracy AI once, turns automatic switching back on, and keeps the old column nullable.

tests: an account with nothing connected has Tracy AI as its whole order, and no tracyFallback
a new connection stands before Tracy AI while Tracy AI is last, else after everything
the saved order must name every connection and Tracy AI exactly once; tracyFallback is ignored
Tracy AI is the last entry by default, and a conversation moved to it stays account fenced
a subscription after Tracy AI in the order is not tried when the one before it hits its limit
Tracy AI first in the order pins the conversation to Tracy AI at once, and it stays there
a conversation on Tracy AI by configuration follows the order once a subscription is put first
an account with no connection at all keeps the plain pin: the deployment default, no broker turn
migration 095: Tracy AI becomes an entry of every saved order, once, and the old flag goes

fence: the broker walks one configured order in which Tracy AI is an ordinary entry; nothing after Tracy AI is tried in a turn, and a pin on Tracy AI by configuration re-reads the order every turn
